# Intact-cat simulation results

[Project home](../README.md) · [Folder guide](../Documentation/project_structure.md)

[**Explore the full trial with a movable four-second window**](Intact_Walking/interactive_experimental_comparison.md). Select joint angles or GRFs, drag the time slider, or jump to Start, Middle or End.

The [Intact_Walking](Intact_Walking/README.md) folder contains the complete 60-second forward calculation from the supplied excitation and model parameters. No body fall was detected over this interval.

The simulation predicts activation, muscle–tendon forces, joint and body motion, muscle moments and raw paw-contact forces. Experimental time series are used for comparison, not to impose the motion or GRFs.

| Open | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [Simulation report](Intact_Walking/simulation_report.md) | Predicted joint angles, contact forces and excitation compared with reference data. |
| [All output files](Intact_Walking/README.md) | Raw numerical arrays, categorized CSV exports, exact parameter copies and source implementation. |
| [Scientific comparison](../Documentation/results.md) | Joint and GRF errors, EMG agreement, definitions and limitations. |

RH references are recorded; LH is an assumed mirror; forelimb references come from a separate study with pooled EMG. Finite-duration walking does not establish stability for all perturbations or complete biological validation.
